$comment: English UI strings. Must have exactly the same keys as pt-BR.json (generator fails otherwise). DRAFT: humanizer pass pending.

strings.proseio_banner_unverified_body: Account created %1$s ago. Not in your contacts.
strings.proseio_banner_external: Account from outside Proseio. We can't verify this person.
strings.proseio_banner_security_change: This account signed in on a new device and isn't verified there yet.
strings.proseio_warning_money_request_body: Before you pay, check with the person another way. Scammers rush you.
strings.proseio_warning_reserved_name: This name is reserved for verified organisations.
strings.proseio_device_approval_never_for_others: Proseio never asks you to approve someone else's login.
strings.proseio_badge_suspended_body: This account signed in on a new device. Verification comes back when the person confirms their identity there.
strings.proseio_warning_nickname_confirm_body: You saved this contact as %1$s. The account is verified as %2$s. Is it the same person?
strings.proseio_pix_card_bank_name: Your bank will show the name %1$s. If you see another name, don't pay.
strings.proseio_warning_name_lookalike_emoji: This emoji can't go next to the name. It looks like a verification badge.
strings.proseio_scam_victim_body: Call your bank now and ask for a refund through MED. The sooner, the better your chance of getting the money back.
strings.proseio_settings_language_footer: Choose Portuguese or English in iPhone Settings.
strings.proseio_about_steward: Proseio is a project by Envisioning. The servers are in Brazil.
strings.proseio_signup_header: You need an invite to join Proseio.
strings.proseio_signup_email_footer: You sign in with this email. Nobody else sees it.
strings.proseio_signup_handle_footer: This is how people find you. You can pick one later.
strings.proseio_signup_success: Account created. Now sign in with your email and password.
strings.proseio_handle_too_short: Too short. Use at least %1$s characters.
strings.proseio_handle_too_long: Too long. Use at most %1$s characters.
strings.proseio_handle_invalid_characters: Use only lowercase letters, numbers, dots and underscores. Start with a letter or number and do not end with a dot.
strings.proseio_handle_cooldown_until: You can change it again on %1$s.
strings.proseio_handle_screen_footer: This is how people find you on Proseio. After a change, you wait 30 days to change it again.
strings.proseio_messaging_everyone_body: People you don't know land in Requests.
strings.proseio_messaging_verified_body: Plus people you already know. Nobody is verified yet, so for now this works like Contacts only.
strings.proseio_messaging_contacts_body: People in a group or chat with you, people you invited and whoever invited you.
strings.proseio_error_invite_invalid: This invite is not valid or was already used.
strings.proseio_error_email_taken: An account with this email already exists. Sign in with it.
strings.proseio_error_password_weak: This password is too weak. Pick a longer or less obvious one.
strings.proseio_error_handle_cooldown: You changed your username recently. Try again later.
strings.proseio_error_rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a bit and try again.
strings.proseio_error_unauthorized: Your session expired. Sign out and sign in again.
strings.proseio_error_network: Cannot reach Proseio. Check your connection and try again.
strings.proseio_error_attestation_invalid: We couldn't confirm this is the official Proseio app. Update the app and try again.
strings.proseio_error_attestation_failed: We couldn't check this phone with Apple. Check your connection and try again.
strings.proseio_signup_display_name_footer: This is the name people see in chats. You can change it later.
strings.proseio_start_chat_handle_not_found: Nobody on Proseio uses @%1$s. Check the spelling.
strings.proseio_profile_qr_footer: Anyone who scans this code opens your Proseio profile.
strings.proseio_link_handle_not_found: We could not find anyone with @%1$s.
strings.proseio_requests_row_body: People who want to chat with you
strings.proseio_request_unverified_body: There is no way yet to know who is behind this account. Only accept if you know this person.
strings.proseio_scam_warning_title: This looks like a common scam
strings.proseio_scam_warning_pix_key: The message has something that looks like a Pix key. Before you pay, check with the person another way, like a phone call.
strings.proseio_scam_warning_pix_code: The message has a Pix copy-and-paste code. Before you pay, check with the person another way and look at the name your bank shows.
strings.proseio_scam_warning_boleto: The message has a boleto code. Fake boletos are a common scam. Before you pay, check in your bank app who gets the money.
strings.proseio_scam_warning_receipt: The message mentions a payment receipt. A screenshot of a receipt does not prove payment. Check in your bank app that the money arrived.
strings.proseio_scam_warning_new_number: Scammers often say they have a new number and pretend to be family. Call the person's old number and check that it is them.
strings.proseio_scam_warning_urgency: Rush and money requests show up a lot in scams. Before you do anything, check with the person another way.
strings.proseio_invite_already_signed_in: You already have an account. Invites are for people not on Proseio yet.
strings.proseio_invites_explainer: Each invite works for one person and lasts 30 days. Invite people you know.
strings.proseio_invites_none_left: You have used all your invites.
strings.proseio_invites_empty: You have not invited anyone yet.
strings.proseio_trust_footer: Only you can see this profile.
strings.proseio_trust_step_email_body: Open a link we send to your email.
strings.proseio_trust_step_pix_body: A R$0.01 Pix from your bank account confirms your name.
strings.proseio_trust_step_govbr_body: A signature with your gov.br account confirms your name.
strings.proseio_voice_transcript_placeholder: Check the text before you send
strings.proseio_voice_transcript_unavailable: No transcript. The audio goes without text.
strings.proseio_stickers_empty_body: Your sticker packs show up here.
strings.proseio_stickers_error_load: The stickers did not load. Try again.
strings.proseio_stickers_import_help: In WhatsApp, send the stickers to a group with only you in it. Then use Export chat, choose Attach media and save the file. Here, choose that file.
strings.proseio_stickers_import_help_folder_andr: You can also choose the files in the WhatsApp Stickers folder.
strings.proseio_stickers_import_note: Imported stickers are stored on the Proseio server without end-to-end encryption. Import only stickers you may share.
strings.proseio_stickers_import_none: No new stickers in that file.
strings.proseio_stickers_import_failed: The import did not work. Try again.
strings.proseio_sticker_save_failed: The sticker was not saved. Try again.
strings.proseio_contacts_intro: See which of your contacts are already on Proseio. Numbers are only compared on the server and are not stored.
strings.proseio_contacts_denied: Proseio has no access to your contacts. You can allow it in iPhone Settings.
strings.proseio_contacts_none: None of your contacts are on Proseio yet.
strings.proseio_contacts_invite: Invite people who are not here
strings.proseio_discovery_toggle: People who have my number can find me
strings.proseio_discovery_footer: Your number is never shown to anyone. Only people who already have you in their contacts can find you.
strings.proseio_phone_not_linked: Your number is not linked yet, so nobody can find you by it for now.
